notes.title: 4月21日更新说明
notes.notes:
-修复额外卡牌撤回撤回bug
-修复商店道具BUG

notes.title: Significantly optimized the gaming experience!
notes.notes:
-Click selection has been uniformly changed to clicking the grid beneath the piece
-Added undo function when selecting targets for spell cards and deploying pieces
-Optimized card recycling mechanics
-Same-name cards are now automatically sorted in the deck editing interface
-Balance optimizations for the Investigation Association deck
-Other bug fixes
